messages:
Rohan: Heads-up — promote to prod is blocked, deploy-bot aborted the canary.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: CI job `canary-integrations` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/job/1749995555 :warning:
Rohan: Quick log snippet: `multipart upload failed: checksum mismatch while finalizing part 4/5`
Marta: Seen this once when the builder image bumped protobuf/gen and cache serialization changed.
Kai: Which PR bumped the builder? @Marta
Marta: PR #901 bumped builder/toolchain last night. It updated protobuf runtime to v3.22.
release: We have a 60m change window starting in ~1.5h. Options: pin the promo to the last-good builder image or block and rollback the toolchain bump.
Kai: Pinning the image keeps the release on schedule; we'll need a follow-up to re-run a full canary after the toolchain fix.
Marta: I'll open a quick MR to pin `redwood/builder:2026-03-01-stable` in the promo job and kick a rerun. ETA ~12m.
deploy-bot: Manual retrigger requested by Marta 12 — job queued: https://ci.redwood/queue/1749995555 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
oncall-bot: Incident CI_UPLOAD_1749995555 created and acknowledged. Escalate if unresolved in 45m.
Rohan: Add a short release-note bullet: "Promotion pinned to previous builder image due to artifact upload checksum mismatch; will re-verify post-release." Mark as `requires-followup`.
Marta: MR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/433 — starting canary rerun.
deploy-bot: Canary rerun started, step `artifact-upload` in progress.
Kai: I'll run a reproducer matrix across builder images and cache server versions to capture the exact serialization diff.
release: If rerun passes we promote and schedule a post-release compatibility canary. If it fails, we reconvene and consider delaying the change window.
Rohan: Execute the pin path for now. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
